paragraphs: I'm applying for the Strategic Finance Associate role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What drew me to Medici is the setup: one finance team building the planning and capital allocation for several brands at once, including brands that are just launching.

At Lenovo I built forecasts, models and scenario analyses to evaluate capital allocation, which improved capital efficiency by 15%. At JPMorgan I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels, benchmarking past allocations against peers and finding 30% efficiency gains to guide where money went next. In my MBA I built a DCF and an LBO model for J.M. Smucker, so packaged food valuation is not new to me.

Deciding where the next dollar goes across David, HallPass and the new brands, and owning parts of the consolidated model, is the work I want to do. I like building a model from a blank page and turning it into a clear recommendation. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
